comparison_tracks.description: Measure whether standing core rules alone prevent compounding TypeScript decay across 4 sequential turns (holds/overlap pricing, multi-room group bookings, fail-closed cancellation config, legacy removal & atomic notify hooks).
Measure whether mechanical diff, structural, architectural, and JS/TS mutation gating prevents compounding TypeScript slop across 4 sequential turns.
Head-to-head comparison of standing prose core rules versus mechanical diff + structural + architectural + TS mutation gates on EV2.

limits: Planned 36-run (144-stage) TypeScript multi-turn evolution pilot; no live model runs executed yet.
EV2 uses zero-dependency erasable TypeScript executed natively via Node.js (`node --test`); replicate across bundled frontend/backend TypeScript repositories before generalizing.
Zero word-cap checks are included by design: every acceptance check is 100% mechanical via benchmarks/graders/grade_ev2.py and gates/mutate.py.
